tooltip.kissmod.proxLibEnabled:
Lets nearby players see your kiss actions without requiring Kiss Mod on the server.
§cWarning: Some anti-cheat systems may flag this as abnormal behavior, risking a kick or ban.§r
How it works: Data is encoded into ABORT_DESTROY_BLOCK packets, which the server relays to nearby players without validation.
